name: error_message_at_its_edges
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1.
procedure: 1. For each kind of refuse and each of the messages (empty, one character, quotes, controls, line separators, U+FFFF, astral characters, composed and decomposed text, 100,000 characters) call refuse with that kind and message.
expected: Each leg's caller receives that kind, that message and, for gone, a Gone whose reason is the message; no other kind has a detail. The two legs give the same outcome (CNF-1).

name: error_generated
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1.
procedure: 1. Draw a kind and a message of Unicode text with no lone surrogate. 2. Call refuse with them.
expected: Each leg's caller receives that kind and that message, over both transports.

name: failure_is_internal_and_names_nothing
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1, in a scope with a timeout of 10 seconds.
procedure: 1. In a scope with a timeout of 10 seconds, whose trace identifier the case reads, call boom, then leak.
expected: Each leg's caller receives internal with the fixed text and the trace identifier of its own scope, no cause and no context, and the provider's host has logged the failure under that identifier, so the identifier reached the provider. The two legs give the same outcome (CNF-1).

name: error_then_reply
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1.
procedure: 1. In one scope call refuse with conflict. 2. In the same scope call echo with a Values.
expected: The first call fails with conflict and the second returns the value sent, over both transports.
